All 257 tests pass, including the new `AcceptanceTest.coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`. The `ERROR` log line earlier was from an existing test that deliberately exercises an error path — it's not a failure.

## Summary

I changed the customerCode format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`nextCustomerCode`** now takes both `city` and `lastName`. It prepends `CITY3` (upper-cased first three letters of the city) and computes `NNNN` as a **per-city** sequence — one more than the number of existing owners whose city matches (case-insensitively) — instead of a global owner count.
- **The call site** passes `owner.getCity()` alongside the last name.
- **membershipNumber** is derived by reading `owner.getCustomerCode()`, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`); I updated its javadoc examples to match. `membershipTier` doesn't depend on the code, so it needed no change.
